senses.gloss: pr. n. (prob. of Greek origin, cmp. pr. n. Σταδιεύς) Saṭda; בן ס׳ son of S., surname of Jesus of Nazareth.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 104b:5">Sabb. 104ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 11:15">Tosef. ib. XI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:15">XII</cite>), 15; Y. ib. XII, end, 13ᵈ <he>והלא בן ס׳ לא הביא וכ׳</he> but did not Ben S. bring sorcery from Egypt only in this way (by making incisions in his flesh)? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:12:2">Y. Snh. VII, 25ᵈ</cite> top <he>כך עשו לבן סוט׳ וכ׳</he> so they did to Ben S. in Lydda, when they made two scholars lie in wait for him &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 16:6:3">Y. Yeb. XVI, 15ᵈ</cite> bot. Sabb. l. c. (in editions not controlled by censors, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) <he>בעל ס׳ בועל וכ׳</he> her husband’s name was S., her lover’s, Pandera; (refuted and changed) <he>אמו ס׳ וכ׳</he> his mother’s name was S. … <he>סַֹטְֹיַת ד̇אֹ וכ׳</he> this one deserted her husband; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 67a:15">Snh. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>סָטַת דא וכ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
